in_marathi.name: Radhey
in_marathi.long_meaning: Radhey हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Radhey is a name of Lord Krishna, who is known to bring joy and delight to those around him. In Hindu mythology, he is often depicted as the embodiment of love and the protector of the earth.
